title: Chapter 765 Changes In The Wind And Cloud; Increase In Strength!
content:
Chapter 765 Changes In The Wind And Cloud; Increase In Strength!

Chapter 765 Changes in the Wind and Cloud; Increase in Strength!

He, Li Tianyao, had sacrificed his entire life for the Dragon Tiger Sect.

In his heart, the Longhu Sect was more important than his own life.

However, perhaps it would not be long before the Longhu Sect ceased to exist.

This was worse than killing him.

However, he had no choice.

That was because he did not want the disciples of the Longhu Sect to suffer more than death.

At this moment, a blue energy flew over from afar and condensed into a large group of men and women with fish heads and human bodies.

They... They were people from the Sea World.

"Sect Master Li, have you finished your instructions?" asked the shark-headed man. "Then, from now on, the Dragon Tiger Sect belongs to my Ocean World!"

Hundreds of years ago, the people of the Sea World had such an experience.

Now that he was doing it, it could be said that he was familiar with it.

Li Tianyao opened his mouth, but it could only turn into a silent sigh.

At this moment, a loud voice rang out among the disciples.

"Belong to the ocean universe? What an arrogant tone!"

"Who is it?" The shark-headed man looked in the direction of the voice and shouted.

"Whoosh!"

An invisible force shot out and instantly sent the shark-headed man flying.

"How dare you!"

"Who is it?"

A series of roars resounded throughout the location of the Ocean Universe World.

What responded to them was a terrifying aura that was as vast as a mountain.

"Boom!"

"Boom!"

"Boom!"

The fish heads fell to the ground like radishes, unable to move their fingers.

This scene shocked everyone from the Dragon Tiger Sect. Their mouths were wide open, and their faces were filled with disbelief.

Then, everyone looked at the person who had spoken earlier.

It was a man wearing a green robe with a long sword hanging from his waist.

"Qiu Liang?" Li Tianyao said in an uncertain tone.

Li Tianyao was Qin Qiuliang's master and knew him very well.

It was precisely because of this that he was even more uncertain.

Because Li Tianyao knew that Qin Qiuliang had good talent. His cultivation had already reached the middle level of the domain lord.

But what was the situation now?

Among the people in the ocean universe, there was no lack of universe level, king level and even emperor level warriors.

They... All of them were suppressed by Qin Qiuliang's words?

This... Am I dreaming?

"Master," said Qin Qiuliang.

Li Tianyao was still a little uncertain.""Your cultivation…"

"Master, I had some fortuitous encounters. In short, from now on, our Dragon Tiger Sect will no longer be afraid of any force!"Qin Qiuliang said.

His tone was extremely serious.

This was the confidence gained from the accumulation of more than 300,000 years in the Ancient Desolate world.

Of course, it was not just confidence.

His strength was indeed enough to protect the Dragon Tiger Sect.

Even though a Sacred Lord had descended to the lower realm of the ocean universe.

....

On the other hand.

Fire God Palace.

A man who was burning like the sun flew above the hall.

Everyone from Fire God Palace knelt on the ground and said,""Greetings, Holy Lord Zhu Sen."

Holy Master!

That's right!

This was a Sacred Lord.

After Zhu Yan's death, the Fire God Palace fell into a period of depression.

However, they did not expect that the Fire God Palace still had a Sacred Master in the higher sky!

This caused the Fire God Palace, which was at its lowest point, to rise up rapidly. Its influence had surpassed Zhu Yan's era in one fell swoop.

Zhu Sen, who was flying in the air, nodded slowly. Then, he said to Li Ke,""Come with me."

Zhu Sen acknowledged Li Ke and gave him a lot of treasures and techniques.

Today, he was even more prepared to head to the mystic realm.

Li Ke learned from Zhu Sen that this secret realm had the opportunity to become a Holy Lord.

He sat in the room and clenched his fists slightly. He felt the rapidly increasing strength in his body and muttered in his heart,"Master, I've become stronger again. Perhaps I can help you in the future."

Even though Li Ke had obtained many benefits from Zhu Sen.

However, his heart was still with Lin Fan.

....

Time flowed like water.

In the blink of an eye, another 50 years passed.

For the past 100 years, Lin Fan had been training hard.

There was a limit to the growth of his cultivation. He had reached a critical point, the peak of Sacred Lord.

However, his strength had increased substantially.

Right now, Lin Fan had four Saint King Grade skills and two Saint King Grade weapons.

In addition, Earth had a defensive formation that could reach the level of a Saint King.

"System, how long can I resist Bodhi?"Lin Fan asked.

[Requires 1 billion spirit stones. Do you wish to inquire?]

Lin Fan said," Didn't I use it last time?""

However, the system did not respond.

Thus, Lin Fan could only say," Consume, consume.""

[100 years.]

When Lin Fan heard that, he heaved a sigh of relief.

Then, he focused his attention on the system interface.

[Host: Lin Fan]

[Cultivation: Peak Holy Lord]

[Skills: Sword 81 (Saint King Level), Curse Technique (Saint King Level), Sword Nurturing Technique (Saint King Level), Cosmos Sword Technique (Holy Lord Level)...]

[Equipment: Star Meteorite Sword (Sacred Lord-grade), Flame Armor (Sacred Lord-grade), Heavenly Soul Pearl (Saint King-grade), True Dragon Sword (Saint King-grade)...]

[Laws: Time (Intermediate), Space (Advanced), Metal (Advanced), Wood (Advanced), Water (Advanced), Fire (Advanced), Earth (Advanced), Life (Advanced), Death (Advanced), Yin (Advanced), Yang (Advanced), Wind (Advanced)…]

[Character Relationship:

Lin Tao, Daddy, Favorability: 10 stars;

[Dai Weixue: Mom, favorability rating of 10 stars.]

Lin Xiaoyao, Sister, Favorability: 10 stars;

Xia Xue: Dao Companion, Favorability 10 stars;

[Xia Bing: Dao Companion, Favorability: 10 stars…]

Lin Fan could no longer improve his skills.

His gaze landed on the Time Law.

Currently, he only had time law at middle-grade. The rest had all reached high-grade.

Some laws were comprehended by oneself.

Some of them relied on magical gems to level up.

However, so far, there were no gems that could upgrade the time law.

It seemed to be a little special.

Lin Fan had a feeling that if he could raise his Time Law to the Advanced Level, he might be able to take a huge step forward.

He thought for a moment and directly entered the river of time.

Lin Fan took a step forward and a thick river appeared in front of him. He walked forward quickly.

In his field of vision, many scenes of the past appeared on both sides. It was like a movie that made people reminisce.

There were scenes of him not being able to afford food when he was young, scenes of him being late for school, scenes of him fighting with others…

Just as Lin Fan was moving forward, the path ahead of him suddenly rippled.

Then, a scholarly man in a long robe appeared.

He looked around and soon, his gaze landed on Lin Fan.

However, the man didn't pay too much attention to it. He walked into the distance.
